title: Family or assisted-use toilet rooms.
officialText:
Family or assisted-use toilet rooms shall include only one water closet and only
one lavatory. A family or assisted-use bathing room in accordance with Section 1109.2.1.3 shall be considered a family or
assisted-use toilet room.
Exception: A urinal is permitted to be provided in addition to the water closet in a family or assisted-use toilet room.
